items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Justin Sun says Tron's post-quantum cryptography has gone live on testnet
items.summary: We're ready to bring quantum resistance to mainnet at any time, Sun said in a post on X.

items.title: Sam Altman-backed Bitcoin life insurer Meanwhile raises more funds
items.summary: The round follows increased international demand for Meanwhile's Bitcoin life insurance policies.

items.title: CFTC Draws the Line Between Prediction Markets and Gambling in New Rules
items.summary: A proposed rule would expressly fold event contracts tied to sports, politics, culture and weather into the swap definition.

items.title: This Sam Altman-Backed Life Insurer Runs Entirely on Bitcoin, and Just Raised $37.5 Million
items.summary: The Bermuda-based insurer, which runs entirely on Bitcoin, drew the funding from existing backers led by Bain Capital Crypto.

items.title: Kalshi is investigating bets on Trump's press secretary pick placed before announcement: WSJ
items.summary: Three bets totaling about $173 were placed before news outlets reported Zacharia's pick.

items.title: Ether ETFs extend outflow streak to nine days as Solana funds snap record 14-week inflow run
items.summary: Spot bitcoin, solana, and ether ETFs all logged weekly outflows.

items.title: Ledger investigates wallet drains involving CryptoBilis buyers; estimate tops $86 million in losses
items.summary: Ledger said it is investigating reports of fund losses from users in Southeast Asia who bought its products from reseller CryptoBilis.

items.title: BTCPay Docker users must opt into Tor at their next update to keep onion access
items.summary: Existing installations must explicitly select Tor at their next setup or update.

items.title: Being right about Bitcoin won't save your 3x leveraged ETF position
items.summary: Bitcoin's next recovery could vindicate your investment thesis but leave your leveraged fund deep in the red because of the fund's daily reset.

items.title: Bitcoin Life Insurer Meanwhile Raises $37.5M as Wealthy Families Look to Pass On Their BTC
items.summary: The Bermuda-regulated startup, whose backers include Bain Capital Crypto and Sam Altman, has now raised more than $180 million.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Shed $729M in Two Days as Investors Reverse Course
items.summary: Investors have fast cashed out of bitcoin exchange-traded funds this week.

items.title: One year after 10/10 flash crash, bitcoin and ether liquidity have rebuilt, but altcoins still face risks
items.summary: Bitcoin and ether order books are deeper than before the crash, while altcoin liquidity keeps eroding.

items.title: Ether bets were wiped out at six times bitcoin's rate in crypto's $1 billion flush
items.summary: About $356 million in ETH positions were liquidated over 24 hours.

items.title: Robinhood Chain slowdown spreads from fees to trading as transactions fall more than 40%
items.summary: Daily activity has dropped from 10.8 million transactions to 6.2 million since mid-September.

items.title: Vitalik Buterin warns against hasty wallet migrations amid growing AI threats
items.summary: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin warned that the crypto industry should take risks to cryptography from AI-accelerated math seriously.

items.title: US plans to seize $1B in crypto linked to Iran this week: Scott Bessent
items.summary: The Treasury Department has announced several digital asset seizures related to sanctions on Iran.

items.title: We Know Where It Is: Treasury Secretary Threatens To Freeze $1B of Iran's Crypto
items.summary: The U.S. will seize $1 billion of Iran's crypto this week, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has said.
